records.name: minimi 2.0
records.tagline: AI cat that closes your open loops
records.description: minimi is personal intelligence that comes to you. We are building a world where before you've said a word, AI already understands you and frees you from the work of managing your own life, so you can spend that time actually living it. Right now, you can adopt AI cats 🐱 on minimi: 1. Cotton captures your personal context so you never explain yourself to AI again. 2. Melody uses this personal context and never lets you miss your commitments More cats 🐈 🐈‍⬛ to come soon...

records.name: IntellAgents.io
records.tagline: One AI agent for every call, chat, and DM
records.description: Most businesses juggle a different tool for every channel — one for phone support, another for WhatsApp, another for the website chatbot. IntellAgents replaces all of it with one AI agent that answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, and handles WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and your website — live 24/7, in up to 36 languages, from a single knowledge base you set up once.

records.name: jev-seo
records.tagline: Free Rust CLI SEO/GEO auditor, no subscription needed
records.description: Semrush and Ahrefs cost $130+/month for work that's mostly deterministic: crawling a site, checking meta tags, validating schema, checking what AI crawlers can see. jev-seo does that in a free Rust CLI. No subscription, no paid API keys needed for the core checks (crawl, audit, schema, robots, sitemap). Optional Jev-powered semantic scoring (intent classification, GEO/AI-citation scoring) needs a free API key. Also ships as an MCP server for coding agents. cargo install jev-seo

records.name: Autonomous Product Delivery
records.tagline: Discover, plan, build, ship, repeat. Product teams run it
records.description: AI coding agents made code fast; delivery still crawls, because coding is one seat in the product cycle. Autonomous Product Delivery runs the whole loop as one system on your real codebase. Ask a question, or let it suggest the next improvement on its own: The final piece in the loop, the new Discover Mode, researches your analytics, tickets, calls, and code, then the system plans, builds, verifies, and hands your engineers a review-ready PR. Every merge makes it smarter.

records.name: Opencontroller by lyzr
records.tagline: Govern All your agents with a unified control plane
records.description: AI agents are sprawling across clouds, SaaS tools, Kubernetes, and devices, with no common layer to govern them. OpenController is the unified control plane that finds every agent, model, and workflow, ships them safely with evaluation and governance, runs real-time monitoring, and turns usage signals into action. Unlike registries that just list agents, OpenController deploys into your own cluster, under your keys and refuses a call in the request path when policy says no.

records.name: NotchPop
records.tagline: The Dynamic Island your MacBook notch was missing
records.description: NotchPop turns your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island: music, a file shelf, clipboard history, focus timer, calendar, weather, AI coding stats and revenue. Works on Macs without a notch too. Native SwiftUI, $3.99 once, 7-day free trial.

records.name: Bitrise Build Hub
records.tagline: GitHub Actions runners that build 2x faster for your agents
records.description: Coding agents push more code, so your CI runs more builds than ever. GitHub's runners are slow, so every extra build sits in the queue and your team waits with it. Bitrise Build Hub runs those builds on the newest Apple Silicon and high-core Linux instead: 54% faster on iOS, 31% on Android. PRs come back in minutes, and your app ships sooner. You keep GitHub Actions. Changing one line in your workflow is all it takes to run on the best runners made for mobile.

records.name: CtrlOps 1.0
records.tagline: Your server. Audited, managed, and deployed with AI.
records.description: Do you actually know who has access to your servers right now? CtrlOps gives you a security hardening score across 25 checks, a PDF audit report, and fix commands for every issue found. See who can log into every server, revoke access from your whole fleet in one click, and assign any level of roles/access without touching the terminal. Every log file, found and searchable without SSH. Deploy any app from GitHub in minutes. 100% local. Your credentials never leave your machine.

records.name: Harness Manager
records.tagline: Your AI coding stack manager, all in one place
records.description: Harness Manager is the App Store and control center for AI coding harnesses on Mac. Discover, install and update tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and more. Automatically detect what’s already installed, manage MCP servers and AI skills, check versions and paths, and diagnose broken installations or configuration issues. Your entire AI coding stack, finally in one place.

records.name: Maximem Synap
records.tagline: The fastest, most accurate memory layer for AI agents
records.description: Maximem Synap is memory and context infrastructure for AI agents, so every conversation does not start from zero. It is the fastest and most accurate memory system on public benchmarks, 92% on LongMemEval and 93.2% on Locomo, with sub-15ms P75 recall. It handles entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and multi-level scoping automatically, no vector database or ranker to tune. Native across 22 frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, and the Claude Agent SDK. Free tier, no credit card required.

records.name: Subscrr
records.tagline: Build a financial plan and ask what to cancel
records.description: Two new things, both in beta. Financial plan: describe your money in plain words and Subscrr lays your year out month by month. Test a purchase or a month without income before you commit, then compare the plan with what actually happened. Subscrr AI: ask where you are overpaying and get findings with the amount each one saves. It opens the subscription so you can cancel, it never does it for you. Still tracks what every subscription really costs per day, month and year.

records.name: Storytailor®
records.tagline: A personal world built around your child’s imagination
records.description: The rebuilt Storytailor turns children’s ideas and drawings into recurring characters and illustrated stories for families, educators and care teams. Read or listen together, explore unfamiliar words with Wonder Words™, and keep going with off-screen activities. Create stories around everyday questions, big changes or pure silliness, with characters that reflect the child’s world. Educator stories include lesson plans. Your first two stories are free.

records.name: ChoreDivider
records.tagline: Split chores by what each of you actually minds doing
records.description: Every chore app asks how hard a chore is, once, for everyone. ChoreDivider asks each of you, in private: how draining is this for you? Ratings stay sealed until everyone is done. Then it deals each day so minutes stay even over 14 days and nobody gets the chore they dread. Every chore says, why it landed with you. No points, no leaderboard.

records.name: Floot MCP
records.tagline: Build and ship web and mobile apps inside Claude or ChatGPT
records.description: Connect Floot to Claude or ChatGPT and build a full-stack app without leaving the chat. Floot gives your AI a ready-to-use workspace with a database, user logins, hosting, and a live URL - nothing to install or configure. Your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription does the thinking, so Floot doesn’t charge based on AI usage. When you’re ready, publish the same project to the web, iOS, and Android, then keep shipping updates from the same conversation.

records.name: NOAN
records.tagline: The fact layer for your AI agents
records.description: Your company has thousands of documents, but only one version of the truth. NOAN turns the facts your business has approved such as pricing, positioning, policies, products, customers, and more into a verified, versioned source of truth available through API and MCP. Connect any model, agent, or app and give them all the same company facts, instead of letting each AI interpret your documents differently.

records.name: Scholé Learn by Building
records.tagline: Learning should be more than "click next"
records.description: Learn by building, on any website, with Scholé by your side. You can read about a tool, watch someone walk through it on YouTube, or ask ChatGPT to explain it. But you won’t properly learn until you build with it yourself. Learn Anywhere mode guides you through using any real tool directly on your screen, adapting tasks and giving visual hints. Everything you learn updates your Scholé knowledge graph and counts towards your lessons. Our thesis? Learn it well enough to use it.

records.name: Hookest
records.tagline: Your swipe file for viral video hooks
records.description: Hookest tracks the opening seconds of viral TikToks, Reels, and Shorts and makes them searchable with real performance data. Study what’s working in your niche, watch competitors, and bring saved hooks into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini through MCP.

records.name: LockLines
records.tagline: Design Mac lock screen messages that fit
records.description: LockLines is a macOS app for designing plain-text lock screen messages that fit the small message area.

records.name: Opaline
records.tagline: PostHog for team Claude Code and Codex sessions.
records.description: Team-wide, message-level analytics for Claude Code and Codex sessions. Track token cost, time, and skill usage for every single message across your team’s sessions. Catch every “You’re absolutely right” from Claude and every “I know, you f*cking idiot” from a frustrated teammate.

records.name: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech models
records.tagline: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
records.description: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

records.name: Parall
records.tagline: Run multiple instances of the same app on your Mac
records.description: Parall lets you run multiple instances of macOS apps and turn websites into Web App Shortcuts with unique Dock icons, custom data paths, HOME overrides, environment variables, Dock effects, file/folder shortcuts, and command-line launchers.

records.name: imemedb.net
records.tagline: The Home Of Internet Calture
records.description: rate your fav meme and make internet great again

records.name: Ageless Atlas
records.tagline: Track your biological age across the 12 hallmarks of aging
records.description: Ageless Atlas estimates your biological age as a proxy across the 12 hallmarks of aging, from a short quiz plus optional labs and DNA — and lets you track it over time. Free, no supplement funnel, and your DNA file is parsed in your browser and never uploaded.

records.name: BranchProof
records.tagline: Review Google Business Profile CSV edits before bulk import
records.description: BranchProof compares original and edited Google Business Profile CSVs locally. Review changed values and potential erasures before importing. Free 100-location preview; the US$19 one-time offline edition adds reviewed CSV and minimal field-patch exports for up to 10,000 locations within file limits. No Google API access or uploads of your CSVs. Existing locations only; use Google's own import preview too.

records.name: Maxxmod
records.tagline: Customize YouTube with more controls and fewer distractions
records.description: Take control of YouTube with 60+ features that remove distractions, customize the interface, and improve playback, all from one settings panel and toolbar popup. Hide Shorts, comments, and recommendations; set default speed and video quality; screenshot tool, and Picture-in-Picture controls; resize thumbnails; use a mini player while scrolling; keep Subscriptions chronological in list view; and clean up noisy search results.

records.name: chipster kids
records.tagline: Teach kids AI literacy through fun, gamified missions
records.description: A UK subscription that teaches children (5+) how AI actually works, where it goes wrong, and how to use it safely — through short, mastery-based missions instead of boring lectures. Built for the gap most parents face: either banning AI completely, or letting kids use it with zero guidance. Chipster Kids sits in between — kids learn through play, parents stay in full control of what's covered and when. No ads, no data selling. Just structured, age-appropriate AI literacy.

records.name: MY-nichi
records.tagline: Habits and daily tasks, simply separated
records.description: MY-nichi is a simple iPhone app that separates the habits you want to keep from the tasks you need to finish today. Instead of just checking things off, you can record how well you did with achievement stamps and look back on your progress through the calendar. Designed in Japan with a focus on simplicity, gentle motivation, and making everyday progress feel rewarding.

records.name: Futurism AI Studio
records.tagline: Create, customize and scale product content
records.description: Futurism AI Studio is a creative platform for brands, creators, and businesses to discover and create visual content with AI. Explore curated visual resources, experiment with AI-powered image and video creation, or work with our creative team for custom solutions. We’re currently in beta and continuously adding new tools, resources, and creative workflows. Join us early, explore what’s available, and help shape what we build next.

records.name: Overdue
records.tagline: Polite invoice follow-ups that help you get paid
records.description: I built Overdue because following up on unpaid invoices is one of those tasks that quietly takes over your week. It helps freelancers and small agencies import their invoice CSV, send polite reminders, and keep track of what happens next. The reminders can become firmer over time, pause when a client replies, and stop when payment is recorded. I’m launching it to get honest feedback from people who deal with late payments regularly. I’d love to know what feels useful, confusing, or still missing

records.name: eylet
records.tagline: Free digital business cards for individuals & teams
records.description: eylet is a free digital business card platform for individuals and teams. Create a professional digital profile, share it instantly with a QR code or NFC product, and keep your contact details in one place. For businesses, eylet makes it easy to create and manage digital business cards across an entire team. Pair your profile with eylet NFC cards, wristbands and other physical products for a simple tap-to-share experience.

records.name: Mitra
records.tagline: Your AI assistant that makes and answers your calls
records.description: Mitra is a personal AI assistant that makes and answers calls from your own number. It can wait on hold, get through phone menus, filter spam, and pick up missed calls. You can set transfer rules, listen live, follow the transcript, whisper instructions, or take over. After each call you get the recording, transcript, summary, and next steps. It can also text, email, and handle calendar and web tasks from connected accounts. On iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with a 15-minute free trial.

records.name: PlayCISO
records.tagline: Practice your CISO decisions before the real breach
records.description: PlayCISO is a security-leadership training platform. Rehearse real breach days in branching "War Room" simulations, drill a mock CISO interview, and get board-report coaching graded against your country's regulators. It also ships free AI-security scanners (npm, packages, browser extensions, models, prompts, MCP servers) and paid security-architect studios — threat modelling, architecture review, org design, and a unified risk register.

records.name: What Does a PPC Agency in Noida Do?
records.tagline: PPC SEO Marketing Agency helps Noida businesses grow online
records.description: A PPC agency in Noida helps local businesses manage paid campaigns through keyword research, targeting, ad creation, landing-page optimization, tracking, and performance analysis. PPC SEO Marketing Agency is a Noida-based digital marketing company offering PPC, SEO, Google Ads, lead generation, and performance marketing solutions. PPC stands for Pay-Per-Click, a form of digital advertising where businesses generally pay when someone clicks on an advertisement.

records.name: Xpectacle
records.tagline: A free Mac window manager, one shortcut at a time
records.description: A powerful window manager for your Mac. Move, resize, and center windows with keyboard shortcuts. Free, open source, and inspired by Spectacle. Move, resize, and center your Mac’s windows with keyboard shortcuts. Xpectacle is a free, open-source window manager inspired by Spectacle, rebuilt in Swift for Apple Silicon.

records.name: AlgoLens
records.tagline: Multi-chain memecoin scanner – security gates + scoring
records.description: AlgoLens is a live multi-chain memecoin scanner. New mints pass through security checks and scoring, then land in three clear lanes (Strong buy, Watch, or Avoid) so you can quickly see the most promising projects in the current market. The Calls tab auto-tracks the scanner’s Strong Buys with real ATH results. Free board available, Elite for new users until Sept 30th.

records.name: ThetaForge
records.tagline: Self-hosted trading journal - journaling in under 5 minutes
records.description: Free and open source trading journal for stocks and options. Imports your Interactive Brokers history via Flex Query, read only, no trading permission. Books assignments, expirations, splits and currencies correctly, calculates time-weighted return, and analyses results per strategy. Runs locally, your data stays on your machine. Free for private use; companies that cannot work with the open source licence can get a commercial licence.

records.name: ImgDoc
records.tagline: Turn images & math formulas into editable Word
records.description: ImgDoc is an online document conversion toolkit that turns images and scanned documents into editable files. Convert images to Word, Excel, and PDF, or PDFs to Word and high-quality images — no installation required. ImgDoc focuses on a difficult OCR problem: converting mathematical formulas from images into editable Word equations instead of screenshots. Works on desktop and mobile for students, teachers, researchers, and anyone working with scanned documents.

records.name: LinkFilm AI
records.tagline: Generative AI canvas workflows for every creative. with BYOA
records.description: The world's best generative image, video, 3D, and audio models — all in one place. Pay as you go; also Bring your own API key from Replicate, OpenRouter, or Fal AI. Use prebuilt components or create your own for reusable generation workflows.

records.name: FlowBotCommander
records.tagline: Desktop bots that find targets by image, not coordinates
records.description: FlowBotCommander automates any Windows program without code. You snap blocks together in a node editor: find image → click → read a value with OCR → wait → repeat → webhook. Targets are located by image recognition and OCR instead of x/y coordinates, so bots keep working when windows move or resize. Runs 100% locally. For single-player idle games, legacy software without an API, screen monitoring with Discord/Telegram alerts, and RSI relief. Free tier: 100 runs/day.

records.name: Discover Daily
records.tagline: 5 things you've never searched, from your own history
records.description: Discover Daily reads your own browsing history locally and figures out which topics you've genuinely never looked into — then hands you 5 of those every morning, from science to languages to history. Not a "recommended for you" algorithm. A curated topic bank filtered against your actual past, so what's left is truly new ground. Nothing leaves your device. No tracking, no analytics. Free to use, with a small Pro tier for more.

records.name: speechio
records.tagline: unprompted speaking practice
records.description: Get a prompt. Talk for 60 seconds. Get scored on filler words, pacing, structure, and delivery. Plus one thing to fix before next time. how is it different from existing product? frankly i can't the exact same type of product like mine, there's some with similiar idea, however they stop at the randomized topic, no eval or area to improve for mine, i go much further, eval, multiple languages, technical prep, double topic, extended time, etc

records.name: MVP.ai
records.tagline: AI companions with personality, bonding, and progression
records.description: MVP.ai is a character-driven AI companion built around personality, bonding, and progression. Instead of a generic chat interface, users interact with a virtual companion that has its own personality and develops through continued interaction. Core features include distinct personality archetypes, a Bond Leveling System, and Quick Sparks for spontaneous conversations. MVP.ai is designed to make AI feel more expressive and personal without replacing human connection.

records.name: I Hate Corrupt Files
records.tagline: Fix corrupt Excel, Word & PowerPoint files, and see why
records.description: Most repair tools are a black box: file in, file out, no idea what changed. This one opens the Excel, Word or PowerPoint file, checks every part against ECMA-376, and shows the exact fault: the XML with a caret on it and the cell or slide it damages. It catches what AI-generated files get wrong: numbers stored as text, formulas whose saved answer is false, XLOOKUP that shows #NAME? on older Excel. No file comes back unless the Open XML SDK accepts it. Free, no account.

records.name: Overnight Curls Without Heat Tips.
records.tagline: Create Beautiful Overnight Curls Without Heat Easily.
records.description: Create beautiful overnight curls without heat using simple styling techniques. Discover easy ways to achieve soft, defined curls or natural waves while you sleep, without relying on curling irons or other heated styling tools.

records.name: gutter cleaning northern beaches​
records.tagline: gutter cleaning gutter services
records.description: Leaves, roof grit, and compacted debris can restrict gutter outlets and cause water to overflow during rain. Westlink Services delivers professional gutter cleaning across Sydney’s Northern Beaches, removing leaves, sludge, and roof debris while clearing gutter channels and outlets and checking downpipe flow. Our service is completed by insured professionals using safe access methods, documented service checklists.

records.name: e-si.ms
records.tagline: More eSIM tariffs, fresher prices and easier comparison.
records.description: e-si.ms is an independent eSIM comparison platform designed to help travelers find the best mobile data deals worldwide. Unlike traditional eSIM stores or comparison websites with limited or manually maintained listings, e-si.ms focuses on real-time pricing and a large, continuously updated database of eSIM plans from multiple providers. Instead of checking dozens of eSIM providers individually, users can compare a large number of available plans in one place.

records.name: ondevice-tools.org
records.tagline: 64 free browser tools that never upload your data
records.description: Free online tools upload your file to a server you know nothing about. OnDevice Tools can't - there is no backend. 64 utilities for developers and everyday work: JSON/XML/YAML/SQL formatters, regex tester, hashing, image compress/resize/convert, PDF merge and split, CSS generators, QR codes and financial calculators. Everything runs in your own tab. No sign-up, no upload, no limits. It works offline once loaded, and it's open source under AGPL so the claim is checkable rather than just stated.

records.name: BenchPing
records.tagline: Customer updates and tracking for independent repair shops
records.description: BenchPing gives independent repair shops a lightweight way to manage repairs and keep customers informed—without adopting a heavy POS. Track every job, send email or SMS status updates, share private tracking pages, collect estimate approvals, add internal notes, attach repair photos, and see every customer touchpoint in one place. Shops can work directly in BenchPing or sync an existing Google Sheet or Excel workflow. The result: fewer “is it ready?” calls and more time at the bench.

records.name: Fate Spoiler: My Orbit
records.tagline: See your whole crew's chemistry on one saju map
records.description: My Orbit is a compatibility map for your whole circle, not just one pair. 🪐 Share one link with friends, coworkers or family, and everyone lands on a shared orbit based on the five elements of Korean Saju. See who fuels you, who burns you out, and who's pure gravity. 🔥 5 bond types, each explained 🌍 One living link that updates as people join 🔒 Free & private Try it now: join the Fate Spoiler dev team's Orbit and see how you'd click with the people who built it.

records.name: ROUTOR
records.tagline: Route by task, complexity, or exact model.
records.description: Routor automatically routes each request to the right capable model based on task and complexity, while keeping the decision visible. Unlike a simple model gateway, you can let Routor choose automatically, select a routing tier, or pick an exact model. Every response shows what was chosen, the category, tier, confidence, and why it was routed that way so you get automation without giving up control.

records.name: PickClub
records.tagline: Run your pickleball leagues & games - all from your phone.
records.description: PickClub is a pickleball league management app. Run your leagues end to end — fixtures, teams, groups, knockout brackets and live leaderboards — then check players in, queue them, and auto-match every game fairly by skill. Clubs, socials, courts and stats built in. On iOS and Android.

records.name: Checkstep
records.tagline: The AI Content Moderation Platform.
records.description: Checkstep is an AI content moderation platform for Trust and Safety teams. It scans text, image, video and audio content, routes decisions through human-in-the-loop queues, and automates DSA and Online Safety Act reporting. Used by Trustpilot, JustGiving and Daily Mail to moderate user-generated content at scale across more than 100 languages.

records.name: Tandem Tales
records.tagline: Turn family adventures into illustrated storybooks
records.description: Most AI story apps begin and end on a screen. TandemTales gets families doing something together first. Parents and children choose a real-world mission—or create their own—complete it together, and capture photos along the way. TandemTales then transforms those moments into high quality personalized illustrated storybook starring the family. With imaginative missions, multiple art styles, and a private story Vault, it turns quality time into a keepsake.

records.name: THE PORTCULLIS
records.tagline: A high stakes twist on medieval dice
records.description: A high stakes twist on medieval dice. In The Portcullis you play as one of three characters (The Knight, The Peasant, The Merchant, The Almoner, The Alchemist or The Thief) all with their own special actions and easter eggs. Includes Medieval Name Generator Play with friends (Online or Pass & Play) or play solo against the Inhumans. You can also try and Beat The Dice in the arcade style Solo Game.

records.name: XianXin AI
records.tagline: See yourself clearly — an AI companion for inner exploration
records.description: XianXin AI is a private AI companion for self-exploration, grounded in psychology and inspired by Zen and traditional symbolism. Chat with text and images on a persistent personal timeline, and cast Xianxin Xiaoliuren — six symbols as doorways to your own experience, not fortune-telling. Conversations are summarized and retrievable without fabricated memories, and can be exported or erased anytime. The tool is a mirror; the interpretation and choice remain yours. Free during beta.

records.name: ProfileIQ
records.tagline: Land the Job. Not the Rejection
records.description: ProfileIQ is an AI resume checker that goes beyond scoring. Paste a job description, get your ATS match score, see exactly which keywords are missing — then get your resume bullets automatically rewritten to close the gap. Free to try.

records.name: AI-Built App Launch Checker
records.tagline: Test your AI-built app before real users find the problems
records.description: AI-Built App Launch Checker is a practical manual testing toolkit for founders, solo builders, and small teams building web apps with AI. It recommends relevant checks for your app and helps you mark PASS/FAIL/NOT NEEDED, log problems, retest fixes, and reach a launch-readiness result. Includes 70 guided checks, a completed example, 12 AI testing prompts, and a Read This First guide. No QA experience required.

records.name: WorkBOS
records.tagline: One workspace for agencies: projects, CRM, real accounting
records.description: Small agencies run on four or five tools that do not talk to each other, and somebody spends Friday reconciling them. WorkBOS puts projects, CRM, HR, payroll and real double-entry accounting on one database, with an AI Chief of Staff that drafts work and waits for a person to approve it. Free for 5 users covers projects, CRM and invoicing. The general ledger and payroll are on Pro at $12 per user per month.

records.name: IDEAgent
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI coding assistant for JetBrains PyCharm
records.description: IDEAgent is a PyCharm AI coding agent you host yourself. Retrieval and context assembly run on your own machine, you choose the model — fully local with Ollama or your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google keys — and the plugin and gateway send no product-usage telemetry back to the vendor. Optional gateway redaction can filter detected secrets out of tool and terminal output.

records.name: Discord Video Compressor by SquishyFile
records.tagline: Squeeze any clip under Discord's upload limit, no upload
records.description: Discord's free limit is 20MB now, and most phone clips blow past it. This tool shrinks your video to fit, right in your browser. Pick your tier (Free 20MB, Nitro Basic 50MB, Nitro 500MB), drop in an MP4, MOV or MKV, hit Squish. You get an MP4 that plays inline in chat. The video never leaves your device. No upload, no signup, no watermark, no file size cap on the source. Free.

records.name: STRATA Academy
records.tagline: Keep research, evidence and writing connected in Notion
records.description: STRATA Academy is a Notion workspace for theses, dissertations, academic papers and evidence-heavy reports. Connect sources, claims, writing, open questions and review decisions as your research evolves. The Personal Edition includes demonstration records and a getting-started guide in English and Portuguese. US$19 through BRUNL LABS.

records.name: Freelance Business Infrastructure
records.tagline: Build a stronger freelance business with practical systems
records.description: This practical guide explains how freelancers can build a stronger business infrastructure instead of relying entirely on individual client projects. It covers workflows, systems, financial structure, client management, automation, and scalable processes designed to support sustainable freelance growth.

records.name: Census
records.tagline: Who's on my Wi-Fi, with the reason when it can't tell
records.description: Every device on your network in one window: name, model, maker, IP, first seen, as a map or a grouped list. New ones get a badge and a notification. When a device can't be identified, Census says why (private Wi-Fi address, asleep, guest-network isolation) and how to check, instead of printing unknown. Runs entirely on your device: nothing uploaded, no account, no location permission. One purchase covers Mac and iPhone, unlimited devices. English and Chinese, macOS 14 or iOS 17 or later.

records.name: Ridvon
records.tagline: Catalyst scan → fundamentals + setup in one desk
records.description: Ridvon is a live market desk for retail traders tired of juggling Yahoo + charts + news tabs. Scan catalysts, open a name, and get fundamentals plus a Grok technical setup (entry / stop / bias) in one place. NFA; no guaranteed returns.

records.name: Mukaan
records.tagline: Turn “we should” into plans that actually happen.
records.description: Mukaan is a private planning app for friends and for yourself. Make one-off or repeating plans, see who’s actually in, get a clear check-in window when it’s time, and keep a simple memory of what happened. No feeds, followers, streaks, or guilt. Just plans that move from “we should” to “we did.”

records.name: ROI Copilot: Real Estate Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate ROI, cash flow & cap rate on any property in secs
records.description: ROI Copilot turns a property listing into a full investment analysis in seconds — annual ROI, monthly cash flow, cap rate, and payback period, plus AI-powered scenario simulations (pessimistic/realistic/optimistic) and an AI negotiation assistant for structuring offers. Built for individual investors and flippers who want fast, data-backed answers before making an offer — no spreadsheets required. Available in Polish and English, with Germany market support coming soon.

records.name: Nutrimetría
records.tagline: Professional nutrition calculations, instantly.
records.description: Nutrimetría is a nutrition calculation platform built for students and professionals. Calculate energy needs, calorie targets, macros, anthropometric metrics and other nutrition estimates in seconds. Results show the formula, assumptions and method behind each calculation, helping you understand and review how the number was obtained. Free to start, with no account required for the first calculation.

records.name: World Radio
records.tagline: Every radio station on earth, one tap away

records.description: Your whole rota, weeks ahead. Set your rota once. Swift Cal maps out every working day ahead, so you can finally plan life around it.

records.name: FREEDOM
records.tagline: Run your business. Focus on your freedom.
records.description: FREEDOM is business operations software built for owner-operators and small service businesses. It brings projects, customers, leads, schedules, equipment, field operations, and multiple businesses into one focused application—giving owners a clear operational picture without relying on disconnected apps, spreadsheets, notes, and memory.

records.name: Workshop Compass
records.tagline: The right product workshop, at the right stage, in order
records.description: Describe your product challenge in your own words and let AI pre-fill the context, or answer 5 quick questions manually. Workshop Compass then recommends the right sequence from 75 product workshops, based on your stage, team, needs and timeframe. Each workshop includes a ready-to-use FigJam board, step-by-step facilitation guide and worked example. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Get To Know You
records.tagline: Quizzes, Games, Questions & More!
records.description: Find conversation starters, take quizzes about yourself, or play games with friends, couples, dates and people you are just getting to know.

records.name: ImperialApply
records.tagline: AI writing and mock interviews for Imperial MSc applicants
records.description: ImperialApply is an independent application preparation platform for Imperial Business School MSc applicants. Get programme-specific support for career planning and personal statements, review your drafts, explore interview question banks, and practise with timed mock interviews and feedback.

records.name: RankBuilder AI
records.tagline: Your AI SEO agent for Search Console & Analytics
records.description: Ask your SEO anything. RankBuilder is an AI agent connected to your Google Search Console, Analytics 4, and a full crawl of your site. Ask which pages lost traffic, what's close to page one, or what to fix first, and it answers with your real data and shows exactly what it pulled. Then say "rewrite this page": it fixes the on-page issues and targets the queries you already rank for, in an editable doc right next to the chat.

records.name: Niche Prompt Generator
records.tagline: Self-contained AI Prompt Matrix tool with $0 operating cost
records.description: Pick a content type, topic and tone. Quill compiles 🚀 I built a micro-SaaS in a weekend using AI, and it’s officially live! Meet my AI Prompt Matrix Tool—designed to turn basic topics into hyper-engineered ChatGPT & Claude prompts for creators. 💡 Built with: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Vercel 💸 Operating Cost: $0 (No database, no API overhead) The best part? It's up for acquisition right now for anyone looking for a turnkey, zero-cost digital asset.

records.name: Snapside
records.tagline: Your project history, automatically captured.
records.description: Bring changes across design, docs, code, and deployment into one timeline. Snapside automatically captures how your product evolves.

records.name: Knock Knock Hello
records.tagline: A website that creates a live chatbot for any domain
records.description: Paste any URL and the website answers the door. It talks back in its own voice, using only what is written on its pages. No signup.

records.name: Fenix
records.tagline: Fênix — Conecte-se, crie laços e viva comunidades.
records.description: Fênix é uma plataforma social feita para criar comunidades, conversar e conhecer novas pessoas. Crie ou participe de Alianças, publique conteúdos, entre em chats e chamadas de voz, acompanhe níveis, rankings e check-ins, além de aproveitar quizzes, minijogos, Aura, histórias e personalização de perfil. Tudo em um só lugar, com foco em interação, identidade e comunidade

records.name: FastTypingLab
records.tagline: Learning and Building faster typing skills
records.description: Free online typing speed test (WPM) in English, Hindi Unicode & Kruti Dev. Practice for SSC, CPCT & UP Police exams, get AI coaching, and play typing games — no signup.

records.name: SpaceScope
records.tagline: See what’s taking up space. Clear it safely.
records.description: SpaceScope is a private, local-first storage visualizer for macOS. Scan a folder or drive to see what’s taking up space, find large files, explore storage visually, and review items safely in Finder before moving anything to Trash. No account required, no file uploads, and no automatic deletion. Built for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, and Apple notarized.

records.name: Waltro
records.tagline: Understand your crypto wallet in plain English
records.description: Most crypto tools are built for people who already understand crypto. Waltro isn't. Paste any wallet address and get a clear, jargon-free explanation of what actually happened — no accounts needed to try it. Built for the millions of crypto newcomers who've stared at a confusing transaction and had no idea what it meant. Free to use, with optional accounts for saved wallets, weekly digests, and portfolio tracking. Also flags known scam-token patterns automatically.

records.name: SaleAndDeal.com
records.tagline: Buy & Sell New or Used Products!
records.description: Your one-stop marketplace for everything. Buy, sell, and discover amazing deals in your area.

records.name: TenderPilot
records.tagline: AI-powered tender screening before you bid.
records.description: TenderPilot reads tender documents, checks them against your company's capabilities, identifies risks, and creates a clear submission checklist.

records.name: Melody Creator
records.tagline: Free melody maker with MIDI and WAV export
records.description: Create a melody online with a playable 16-step grid. Choose key, scale, tempo, chords, instrument, presets, or random melody ideas, then download your melody as MIDI or WAV.

records.name: SSL Certificate Checker
records.tagline: Check SSL certificates and website security instantly
records.description: SSL Certificate Checker provides real-time SSL/TLS analysis for one website or multiple domains at once. Review certificate validity, expiration timelines, issuer information, encryption details, technical specifications, and security recommendations from one mobile-friendly dashboard. It also keeps a history of recent checks all available free without signup.

records.name: SiteConnect AI
records.tagline: 24/7 AI Assistance and Lead Machine
records.description: SiteConnect AI - Capture 3x more leads 24/7 with AI. Affordable lead generation for any business. $149/month. Free 7-day trial.

records.name: Zenda
records.tagline: Correo Argentino shipping for WooCommerce and Shopify
records.description: Zenda puts Correo Argentino's real shipping rates in your WooCommerce or Shopify checkout, priced from the cart's weight and size. Buyers choose their pickup branch, and you load each shipment into MiCorreo from the order. Free edition on WordPress.org.

records.name: PaycheckBeacon
records.tagline: Estimate take-home pay in every U.S. state
records.description: Estimate 2026 take-home pay across all 50 states and DC with transparent federal, FICA and state assumptions, then explore focused salary and payroll tools.

records.name: Flowsheet
records.tagline: A spreadsheet for people who hate spreadsheets.
records.description: FlowSheet is an AI-powered spreadsheet designed for people who want the power of spreadsheets without the complexity. Start with ready-made templates for budgeting, financial forecasting, CRM, project management, accounting, staff scheduling and more. Edit cells directly, collaborate with your team, import existing spreadsheets and use AI to help organise and understand your data.scheduling, inventory, property and more — without complicated formulas. […]

records.name: OASM
records.tagline: Open-source, self-hosted attack surface management
records.description: Open-source, self-hosted attack surface management. Discover, monitor and secure your internet-facing assets with AI-assisted analysis — deploy with Docker in minutes.

records.name: FMC4ME
records.tagline: one centralized platform
records.description: Discover how to use the FMC4ME login to access Fresenius Medical Care tools, view schedules, and manage work details easily.

records.name: Bracketree
records.tagline: Free tournament bracket generator — no signup
records.description: Every bar league, school event and office pool needs a bracket — but the options are fixed PDFs you can't type on, or platforms that make you create an account and a whole "tournament" first. Bracketree is the missing middle: single; double elimination or round robin, 4–32 teams with byes handled, type names on the lines, print one clean sheet. No signup, nothing leaves your browser.

records.name: PostBox
records.tagline: Write to someone new. You might find a lifelong friend.
records.description: PostBox is a free pen pal app for Android where you send and receive personalized digital postcards and letters to people in 150+ countries. Discover new friends through shared interests. Download free on Google Play.

records.name: Aiverio
records.tagline: Discover and compare the best AI tools
records.description: Aiverio is an AI tools discovery platform that helps users discover, compare, and understand modern AI software. Explore AI tool reviews, software comparisons, automation workflows, and practical guides to find the right AI solutions. Aiverio helps people save time by finding the best AI tools for their needs.

records.name: Construction Calculator USA
records.tagline: Free construction calculators for US projects
records.description: Construction Calculator USA is a free collection of practical calculators for contractors, builders, DIYers, and homeowners. Estimate concrete, roofing, drywall, flooring, materials, dimensions, and other common construction needs in one place. No account, subscription, or installation required — choose a calculator, enter your measurements, and get the result instantly.

records.name: Robots & Villas
records.tagline: Luxury Stays. Robotic Experiences
records.description: Discover extraordinary villas where robots and AI become part of the experience.

records.name: Iris - Your iMessage Thought Partner

records.description: Iris is an iMessage thought partner created by Flagship Labs 105, Inc., a Flagship Pioneering company. Available via iMessage and RCS, Iris helps you talk through your thoughts, reflect on your feelings, and explore life’s questions with a supportive, judgment-free AI thought partner. Iris is not a medical or clinical service.

records.name: QuizBrothers
records.tagline: AI-powered live pub quiz platform with offline mode
records.description: A complete live quiz platform for professional quizmasters. We upgraded from paper sheets because no existing app met our needs. QuizBrothers features 7 question types, complete custom branding, live score adjustments, cheat detection, and dynamic live graphs. New in this launch: Native MCP AI integration. Connect directly to ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to generate fully formatted trivia rounds instantly. Run a TV-style game show effortlessly.

records.name: Lyrics to Song AI
records.tagline: Turn your lyrics into complete AI-generated songs.
records.description: Lyrics to Song AI is a lyrics-first AI music creation product for songwriters, lyric writers, poets, and personal creators. Start with your own lyrics, continue into AI song generation, manage creations in a private library, generate new lyrics when needed, or convert supported audio into MIDI for further editing. Free credits are available after registration, while paid-credit generations include commercial-use rights under the current product terms.

records.name: Dev Sec
records.tagline: Stateless AI code auditor with absolute privacy (BYOK)
records.description: Developers frequently need fast, AI-powered assistance to audit code, spot security vulnerabilities, and check dependencies. The Solution: DevSec AI is a lightweight, stateless code auditing utility built for developers who care about security and data privacy. It operates entirely on a Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) model, meaning it doesn't store your source code, history, or API keys anywhere on a backend server.

records.name: TockMai
records.tagline: AI finds your next export customer — and scores the fit
records.description: TockMai is an AI-powered B2B lead generation platform that finds global buyers, verifies decision-maker contacts, and scores every match 0–100 — so exporters only chase leads worth calling.

records.name: Palette

records.name: Quickenlancer

records.name: AnywhereDesign

Test your live React frontend on your tablet, speak engineering directives, and watch your local AI modify code with zero-flicker hot reloads. Keep your code private on your machine—no cloud uploads, no laggy VNCs.

records.description: Diti is a unified, true no-code A/B testing platform for web and mobile apps. Powered by build-time AST compilation, it lets product teams visually build, preview, and ship UI variations over-the-air without waiting on engineering release cycles.

The hosted Platform adds the full loop: verify your domain, run a full audit, get findings with evidence, apply a suggested fix, then retest to confirm it's gone.

records.name: Type Write Now

records.description: Stop letting competitors become the answer. UseWok turns AI visibility from another job into work already done. We build the public footprint AI assistants can use to discover, understand, and mention your SaaS—without handing you a single task. No scores to decode. No strategy to execute. No accounts to connect. We handle the complex work end to end and document every result. You build the product. We make it harder for AI to overlook. $59 once.

records.description: Host your Tambola and Housie games hassle-free with Tambola Number Caller App. No need to manually pick or announce numbers—our smart app handles automatic caller voice announcements in multiple speeds, keeps a clear visual board, and tracks game history in real time. Perfect for family gatherings, party games, and community events. Features flexible auto-call delays, customizable audio options, clean UI, and offline support for seamless group entertainment anytime, anywhere!

records.name: Mood Daily
records.tagline: Track your mood daily, spot patterns, build a streak
records.description: Mood Daily helps you track how you feel every day in seconds. See your mood patterns over time with a Year in Pixels calendar, build a daily streak, and get gentle care nudges when you need them. No sign-up, just open and log.

records.name: TOP10music.today
records.tagline: Global music charts and discovery from YouTube & Spotify
records.description: TOP10music.today is a global music discovery platform showing Top 10 charts by country and worldwide. It combines YouTube and Spotify data to help people discover popular songs, compare music trends across countries, and build their own favorites and playlists.

records.name: Bill Check
records.tagline: Never miss a bill again
records.description: Bill Check is a simple, private bill tracker that helps you stay ahead of recurring payments. Track fixed and variable bills, get reminders before they’re due, see what’s paid and what’s coming up, and organize bills for everyone in your household. No account required — your data stays on your device. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: builtwithlaya
records.tagline: Unofficial gallery of public Laya decision-model builds
records.description: An unofficial catalog of 22 public builds using ConvAI's open Laya decision model. Not their Hugging Face repo, not their official demo, and not affiliated with ConvAI. Send a public link; a person checks it before it is listed.

records.name: WatchWise
records.tagline: A calmer way to choose what plays next
records.description: WatchWise helps you decide what to watch without losing the evening to browsing. Set the time you have, your mood, and your streaming services, then get focused Tonight's Picks from a curated catalog of 650+ titles. Save picks, plan the week, and spend more time watching.

records.name: Nomily
records.tagline: Bring your own AI to your voice recorder
records.description: Nomily is a BYOK AI companion for voice recorders. Sync or import audio, transcribe, summarize, and choose your own AI provider. Currently supports Vobot V05E, with iOS and Android clients plus Apple Watch recording.

records.name: Bliteoc
records.tagline: Find work. Post work. Get things done.
records.description: Bliteoc is a work marketplace where businesses and individuals can post jobs, tasks, gigs, and affiliate opportunities, while skilled people can discover and apply for work. It brings different types of work into one platform, with tools for posting opportunities, managing applications, and connecting people who need work done with people ready to do it.

records.name: Kustom Tailor
records.tagline: Just be YOU
records.description: Kustom Tailor is a mobile app that empowers you to design your own outfits or choose from a curated collection right from your phone—choose your style, get measured, and let expert tailors bring it to life. No stress, no guesswork—just a flawless fit every time.

records.name: Sponsee App

records.description: Run your sponsorships like an agency. Keep 100%. Fla pricing, no cut — and your money never passes throuh us.

records.name: Tool Inventory
records.tagline: Know what you own, where it is, and when it needs service.
records.description: Tool Inventory was built to be useful without feeling like enterprise software. Track tools and equipment by location, organize storage with QR-coded bins, record serial numbers and values, and keep everything searchable. Optional add-ons expand it into maintenance, consumables, job tracking, tool checkout and storage planning when you need them.

records.name: ByDesign AI Canvas
records.tagline: The first planner that thinks with you.
records.description: Three things landed in ByDesign this month. An AI that takes any goal and builds the real plan. Steps, resources, courses, all scheduled across your year. An assistant you can just talk to. Reshuffle the week, find time for tasks, schedule meetings on the go. And a canvas that's flexible to how you plan. See the next ten days, a quarter, the whole year, or whatever view makes sense to you.

records.name: BillingGenerator
records.tagline: Free Invoice, Receipt & Pay Stub Generator. No Signup.
records.description: Create professional invoices, receipts, pay stubs, estimates, and proforma invoices for free. No signup required. Instant PDF download. 160+ currencies. 100% browser-based.

records.name: QuickLook Pro
records.tagline: Preview 300+ file formats directly in Finder
records.description: Preview Markdown, SQLite, ZIP, JSON, CSV, source code, logs and 300+ other formats with the spacebar. Select a file. Press Space. See what's inside, without opening another app. Native. Private. No account. No subscription.

records.name: The Menu Hub
records.tagline: Know the menu. Know the price. Decide where to eat.
records.description: Find the latest UK restaurant menus and current food prices at The Menu Hub. Browse up-The Menu Hub is a UK food platform built to make restaurant decisions easier. Find menus, prices, calories, deals and dining information in one place, so you can see what’s available and what it costs before heading out. We’re building a more practical way to discover restaurants and plan meals without jumping between multiple websites, apps and menus.

records.name: Find The Pieces: Puzzle Tales
records.tagline: Relaxing Storybook Puzzles
records.description: Discover charming pictures one piece at a time in Find The Pieces: Puzzle Tales! Drag, match, and merge scattered pieces to complete beautiful storybook scenes. Meet adorable animals, explore colorful worlds, and enjoy relaxing puzzles designed for players of all ages.

records.name: Cue for Monitors
records.tagline: Save your window layout as a scene, restore it in one key
records.description: Cue saves how your windows sit across every display as a scene and puts them back with one keystroke.

records.name: Playnook Games
records.tagline: 16 free browser games — chess, sudoku, snake, and more
records.description: Play 16 free browser games instantly — Chess vs AI, Checkers, Sudoku, Word Nook, Solitaire, Connect Four, Minesweeper, Bubble Pop, Cosmic Clicker, Neon Dash, Snake, 2048 and more. No download, no sign-up. Track your streak and beat your best score.

records.name: Predictive Dialer
records.tagline: Smart Predictive Dialer for Outbound Contact  Centers
records.description: This Predictive Dialer solution helps contact centers manage outbound campaigns by placing calls based on agent availability and campaign activity. It helps reduce idle time, organize lead calling, and keep agents focused on live conversations instead of repetitive dialing tasks. Explore Solution: https://kingasterisk.com/services/predictive-dialer

records.name: Nashir
records.tagline: Connect your code. Nashir does the rest.
records.description: No config file: Nashir detects your project and runs your frontend, backend and databases — on our servers or yours, close to your users — and your agent deploys over MCP.

records.name: DevTooling
records.tagline: 23 dev tools. One tab. Zero uploads.
records.description: DevTooling brings everyday developer utilities into one free workspace. Run XSLT 1.0–3.0 transformations; format, validate, convert and compare XML, JSON, YAML, CSV and EDI; work with PDFs; and build cron expressions. No signup or installation required. Most tools run entirely in your browser, keeping your data on your device.

records.name: PixelInspector, demystify pixel tracking
records.tagline: Make marketing pixel activity easy to understand
records.description: Most pixel tools show a stream of network requests. Pixel Inspector connects page visits, clicks, and form submissions to the marketing events that follow. It groups events by vendor and destination ID, makes payloads searchable and readable, and exports shareable reports. It requires no account or setup, and inspection data stays in your browser.

records.name: OsmO
records.tagline: Personal assistants that answer and make calls for you
records.description: Assistants by OsmO are AI phone agents that screen calls, transfer urgent ones, collect requests, and share call summaries. They also make outbound calls, navigate phone menus, and handle recurring calls. Available on iPhone and Android with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Trail Hilight
records.tagline: Build for those who follow the roads.
records.description: Trail Hilight - Built for nomads & travelers. Track your journeys, pin bucket-list destinations, share travel stories, and connect with fellow nomads worldwide.
